chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Bishr ibn Maslama from Misma' Abu Sayyar from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever gives charity when he awakes in the morning, Allah removes the bad omen of that day from him.

key_terms.نحس: Bad omen / misfortune — ill luck or calamity

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of giving charity in the morning according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that giving charity in the morning wards off the misfortune of that day. This hadith, narrated in al-Shaykh al-Saduq's assembly of 368 AH, reflects the Islamic practice of beginning the day with an act of generosity as a spiritual shield against calamity.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Ayyub b. Nuh from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Bishr b. Maslama from Masma` Abi Sayyar from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq (as). He said:
Whoever gives charity when he awakes, Allah removes the bad omen of that day from him.
